items.title: NASA Taps Blue Origin for Mars Communications Network
items.summary: NASA has been communicating with Mars on hardware that predates the iPhone, the cloud, and 4G. On Tuesday, the agency announced that it had selected Blue Origin to give that infrastructure a modern upgrade. The contract—valued at ~$700M—tasks Blue Origin with developing NASA’s Mars Telecommunications Network (MTN).
